title: The versioning states of a bucket
claim: A bucket can switch between versioning-enabled and suspended, but it can never return to an unversioned state.
alt: A state diagram with three states: unversioned, versioning-enabled and versioning-suspended. Enable leads from unversioned to enabled; suspend leads from enabled to suspended; enable leads back from suspended to enabled. No arrow returns to unversioned.
notes: Brief 21; 2-deep.md#versioning-turns-a-delete-into-a-delete-marker-and-keeps-every-version, after the trace; caption, no steps. Claim, alt, states and transitions from brief.json.
